title: Account Opening and Activation — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
### Placement on a plan

A Pocketwire Personal Account opens in applied status on the plan whose entry requirements the applicant meets. A sign-up without completed identity verification opens on Pocketwire Lite, and every other plan requires the identity verification status verified.

### Minimum age

The applicant's date of birth on the customer profile shows they are at least 18 years old on the opening date. Age is counted in whole years from the date of birth to the opening date, and a birthday falling on the opening date counts as reached. The age is read from the system record of the customer profile, correlated to the applicant opening the account.

| Illustrative situation (hypothetical dates) | 18 years reached on the opening date? |
|---|---|
| The applicant's 18th birthday falls on the opening date | Yes — the birthday counts as reached |
| The applicant's 18th birthday falls on the day after the opening date | No — only 17 whole years have been completed |
| The applicant turned 18 some years before the opening date | Yes |

### Opening values

The opening ledger balance is 0.00. The billing cycle is recorded as not applicable on Pocketwire Lite and Pocketwire Core, and a paid plan chosen at sign-up starts its trial or first plan fee on the opened date under the plan fee rules of the Pocketwire Personal Account.

### Activation and decline

Activation from applied to active, and decline from applied to closed, are set by the Customer Identification Program check, never by a support representative. A representative explains the outcome but cannot override it, and a declined applicant may sign up again only as a new application.

| Outcome of the Customer Identification Program check | Account status afterwards | Can a representative change it? |
|---|---|---|
| Passed | Active — the account opens for payments | No |
| Declined | Closed — the account never opened | No; the applicant may sign up again only as a new application |
